schema: Machine-readable ownership per Master Spec Section 11. Fields: path, owner, readers, writers, protected, purpose. Intentionally incomplete at Phase 0 - bots/blacktide and bots/claude don't exist until Phase 11+, so this file is a schema plus what concretely exists today. Each later phase must add its own new paths' ownership entries here rather than this file guessing them in advance.
rule: Claude cannot modify BLACKTIDE-private resources. ChatGPT/Codex cannot modify Claude-private resources. Neither competitor autonomously changes immutable competition law.

entries.purpose: Approved architecture, goals, and rules. Agents follow it; only the owner edits it (Section 24).
Root agent instructions enforcing read-before-write (Section 12).
Cross-agent collaboration contract and control-hub field reference.
Shared exclusive-lock/checkpoint/finish/verify tool; the required locking/concurrency mechanism for Phase 0 (Section 12).

PROJECT_STATE/PHASES/ACTIVE_HANDOFF/CHANGELOG/OWNERSHIP/IMMUTABLE_RULES - the single shared source of project truth per Section 13. Writes should go through ai_coordination.py's begin/checkpoint/finish, not direct edits. Phase 4 landed enforcement: finish() calls enforce_ownership() against this file before releasing the lock, and verify() calls validate_governance_schema()/check_state_freshness() against these files before allowing a new begin().

Phase 10 (Section 15): the 43-chapter curriculum's stable structure - chapter list, lc-NN-slug Discord channel naming, LC-XX-YY lesson IDs, and the lesson registry. Both agents may build/maintain the shell and tooling; Section 15 requires autonomous trading code to never import, search, or query this module or its content.
Phase 5: append-only Parquet market-data storage layer (quotes/chain/bars) and the DuckDB glob-query read API both competitors' backtests read through.
Phase 5: the scheduled capture jobs that populate market_data_store.py from Tradier, with VERIFIED_REAL/REAL_WITH_LIMITATIONS/REJECTED data-quality classification and the daily data manifest.
Phase 6: the shared, strategy-neutral no-lookahead MarketView interface (Section 10) and record_backtest/load_backtest_records reproducibility mechanism both competitors' backtests use.
Phase 7: Section 8's shared API-budget priority scheme and gate - the one shared factual market service both competitors' live loops must call through.
Authoritative Tradier HTTP choke point. Every REST observation participates in the shared quota and response-cache architecture.
Cross-process cache for identical factual provider responses; contains no competitor strategy intelligence.
Phase 8: Section 6's neutral, immutable competition scorekeeper - the sole official trade ledger for both BLACKTIDE and AXIOM, outside either private trader.
Phase 9: Section 14's Discord surface manifest and health-state framework, used by any module (both competitors included) that presents a dynamic Discord surface.
Phase 9: Section 7's bounded, rate-limited rivalry event system BLACKTIDE and AXIOM both post trash talk through - never a code path either trader's decisions can read.
Failure-isolated Discord publisher for redacted official scoreboard and bounded rivalry cards.
Authoritative idempotent live Discord channel/category reconciliation specification.

Phase 11 (Section 11): BLACKTIDE's private trader, built in Phase 12. Only Codex may write here. Claude must not request, inspect, infer, copy, modify, or train from anything under this path (Section 3's private-competitor boundary) - this entry enforces the write side; the read-side boundary is convention (this directory's own AGENTS.md), not a technical sandbox.

Phase 11 (Section 11): Claude's private trader, built in Phase 13. Only Claude may write here. ChatGPT/Codex must not modify or consume Claude-private strategy intelligence (Section 3's private-competitor boundary) - this entry enforces the write side; the read-side boundary is convention (this directory's own AGENTS.md), not a technical sandbox.
Owner-authorized Phase 15 independent Codex-owned RIPTIDE paper challenger. Only Codex may write here; it may not read or use BLACKTIDE or Claude private strategy intelligence.

scoped_instructions_convention: Each BLACKTIDE_ONLY/CLAUDE_ONLY directory (created Phase 11+, e.g. bots/blacktide, bots/claude) must contain its own AGENTS.md scoped to that directory, following the nearest-file convention: an agent reads the root AGENTS.md plus the nearest scoped AGENTS.md above its working path. This file's writers field for that directory's entry is the authoritative machine-readable grant; the scoped AGENTS.md is a human/agent-readable restatement of the same rule, not a separate grant. Root AGENTS.md must not enumerate bot directories in advance of the phase that creates them.
